title: GPU-vs-CPU byte-identity harness (DVB-T2 chain)
description:
## Goal

Property-test harness asserting byte-identity of the three
deterministic columns (`fer`, `frames`, `errors`) between CPU-only
and CPU+GPU paths on the DVB-T2 chain at fixed seed. `mean_iters`
is logged but NOT asserted (excluded per `ec530af9` §11 due to
RDNA2 transcendental ULP drift). Also lands the CLAUDE.md
amendments that close Story `1f588e2a` (Phase B).

## AMENDMENT 2026-06-09 (user-approved — NO rigor change; scope-correction + stale-doc sweep)

Three corrections after the first formal `code-review`, all user-approved
(the byte-identity rigor is fully retained):

1. **Deliverable-1 path mechanism: hand-composed, not `Pipeline`-driven.**
   The runnable hybrid `Pipeline` does not exist until Phase C
   (`75c22fa8` scheduler + `de160fc5` executor); `pipeline.rs` is a Phase-A
   scaffold with no run method. This task therefore HAND-COMPOSES the
   CPU-only and CPU+GPU paths from the Phase-A frame-level building blocks
   (encode / interleave / map / AWGN / demap / decode / BCH), differing only
   in which device runs the GPU-eligible stages, and asserts the same
   three-column (`fer`/`frames`/`errors`) byte-identity at a non-vacuous
   waterfall. The **`Pipeline`-DRIVEN** CPU-vs-GPU regression (mode C =
   `Pipeline::dvb_t2()...with_gpu(true).build()`, A-vs-C three-column over
   all six MODCODs) is owned by **D.3 `0d9cb8e3`** after the Phase C executor
   lands — it already carries that deliverable. This MOVES the `Pipeline`
   mechanism to the completing node; it does not weaken the contract.

2. **`mean_iters` logged for BOTH paths (criterion-2, finding-1 fix).**
   The GPU LDPC launcher already tracks each frame's first-convergence
   (freeze) iteration; the GPU stage now surfaces per-frame iteration counts
   so the test logs GPU `mean_iters` and the CPU-vs-GPU diff (still NOT
   asserted — §11 CPU-vs-GPU exclusion). No prior `n/a`.

3. **Stale design-doc §6 reconciled (criterion-4, finding-2 fix).**
   The landed detection code (`36075e4c`) uses name-based `gcnArchName`
   detection (correctly distinguishing gfx940/gfx942, which share a compute
   capability); design-doc §6 still said compute-capability
   `hipDeviceGetAttribute(major, minor)`. Design-doc §6 is corrected to match
   the landed code (+ the expanded arch table), and CLAUDE.md quotes the
   corrected §6 verbatim. The §5 crate-boundary diagram is added verbatim.

## Context

Task under story `1f588e2a` (GPU stages) within epic `gf2-sim`
(`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §11 (determinism contract
with CPU-vs-GPU relaxation), §6 (multi-arch dispatch). Wave B.4:
depends on `ed575f15`.

This is the Phase B closing task: tests the CPU-vs-GPU
byte-identity contract (three columns; `mean_iters` excluded) and
lands the CLAUDE.md amendments per project plan §7 and Q5 decision.

## Deliverables

1. `crates/gf2-sim/tests/gpu_byte_identity.rs` (under `--features hip`):
   - For each of (r1/2 16-QAM, r2/3 64-QAM, r3/4 16-QAM):
     - Run a 200-frame batch via a HAND-COMPOSED CPU-only path
       (the Phase-A frame-level building blocks; the runnable
       `Pipeline` is a Phase C deliverable, see AMENDMENT above).
     - Run the same batch via a HAND-COMPOSED CPU+GPU path
       (Phase B GPU stages active) on gfx1030.
     - **Assert byte-identity of `fer / frames / errors`** (three
       columns; `errors` = FRAME errors per `WorkerCounters`).
     - Run at a NON-VACUOUS waterfall operating point
       (`0 < errored_frames < frames`, asserted).
     - **Log** `mean_iters` from each path and the diff; do NOT
       assert (excluded per `ec530af9` §11, user-approved Q3
       2026-06-07). GPU `mean_iters` is surfaced from the launcher's
       per-frame freeze iteration (AMENDMENT item 2).
     - Assert BER **excluded** (status-quo amendment from `152388f4`,
       cited in a comment).
2. The test is gated `#[cfg(feature = "hip")]` so the default CI
   matrix (non-ROCm hosts) skips it; the gfx1030 CI job runs it.
   One `#[ignore]` test per config to stay under the 120 s
   slow-tier cap.
3. CLAUDE.md amendments (Phase B close):
   - Add the multi-arch HIP target list per design-doc §6.
   - Add the HIP dispatcher model paragraph (cite design-doc §5).
   - Add the GPU-vs-CPU byte-identity contract per design-doc §11
     INCLUDING the `mean_iters` exclusion with its rationale.
4. Receipts:
   - Append a `gpu-stages-receipts.md` entry summarising the
     byte-identity attestation (three columns) + per-kernel
     throughput pointers into `parallelism-receipts.md`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Property test passes byte-identity for `fer / frames /
  errors` (three columns) between CPU-only and CPU+GPU paths at
  fixed seed for the three named (rate, modulation) configurations
  on gfx1030, at a non-vacuous waterfall operating point.
- [hard] Property test logs `mean_iters` for both paths and the
  diff; does not assert.
- [hard] Test is `#[cfg(feature = "hip")]`-gated so default CI
  matrix passes without HIP.
- [hard] CLAUDE.md updated with the three items above; quoted from
  design-doc §5, §6, §11 verbatim per memory rule
  `feedback_quote_ssot_formulas_verbatim` (design-doc §6 corrected
  to the landed name-based detection first — AMENDMENT item 3); the
  `mean_iters` exclusion explicitly noted.
- [hard] `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/gpu-stages-receipts.md` entry
  present linking to the per-kernel receipts.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review`, `tests` gates green.

## Non-goals

- BER inclusion in byte-identity (excluded per status-quo).
- `mean_iters` inclusion in CPU-vs-GPU byte-identity (excluded per
  `ec530af9` §11, user-approved Q3 2026-06-07).
- The `Pipeline`-driven CPU-vs-GPU regression (owned by D.3
  `0d9cb8e3` after the Phase C executor lands — see AMENDMENT).
- Production sweep (owned by `e4849f07` after `bbf6b6ee` lands).
